# HEIC regression fixture

`rainbow.heic` is the small synthetic rainbow image from the libheif test suite:
https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/master/tests/data/rainbow-451x461.heic

Downloaded October 28, 2026. SHA-256: `4b2ce727f093944975f143ba2b39c4c64511b766d94552f8d51a755916e7f983`.
The unmodified upstream `COPYING` notice is included alongside it. This is a synthetic decoder test asset, never business work or a customer photograph. Tests are offline after checkout.

Runtime dependency `heic-decode` uses the replaceable `libheif-js` WASM package. Preserve their license notices and source links when packaging/distributing. No native app or binary release is produced here.
